verdict.rationale: Notion's integrations directory describes native connections that sync data, automate workflows, and connect common tools, and it lists a GitHub sync integration. It also shows embed-style integrations such as Loom, Tableau, and Figma-like design tools. An older community comment asked why Notion lacked a GitHub integration, but the current directory listing appears to supersede it, so I treat it as outdated rather than a dispute. Missing for 10: any evidence of native Slack or Google Drive integrations, detail on what the GitHub sync actually does, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the native integrations work.
